optimizedContext.value:
# Agent Instruction Template

## Rules
- Export shared Handlebars `templates/prompt/agent-instruction.md.tpl`: `/specd` orientation (`project status --context --graph`), `/specd-new`, graph-first research (generic search/read fallback), stale index→`graph index --format toon`, TOON examples for symbol/impact/dependency/hotspot/spec search, workflow/skill-stop/escape-hatch rules. Optional nonempty `extraInstructions` renders inside base `<!-- <specd> -->` block.
- Export `renderBaseAgentInstruction(options?): Promise<string>`; `options.extraInstructions?:string`. Empty/omitted produces clean prompt, no empty trailing section.
- Export `injectSpecdBlock(filePath, content, blockId?)` and `removeSpecdBlock(filePath, blockId?)`. Base delimiters: `<!-- <specd> -->…<!-- </specd> -->`; identified delimiters: `<!-- <specd-plugin:<blockId>> -->…<!-- </specd-plugin:<blockId>> -->`. Inject inserts/updates while preserving surrounding user content.
- Empty inject: base does not add empty tags; identified block removes existing and adds none. Remove leaves no orphan tags. When final plugin-specific block removed from shared file, remove base block too.
- Shared instruction targets: each plugin injects nonempty identifying registration with `blockId=pluginName` alongside base. Exclusive files use base only.
- Export `mergeJsonConfig<T>(filePath, updater)` / `unmergeJsonConfig<T>(filePath, updater)`. Merge parses existing or uses `{}` for absent/invalid, creates parents, preserves untouched top-level properties; unmerge absent/invalid = no-op. Both formatted 2 spaces + trailing newline.

## Constraints
- Preserve user content; marker registration enables reference-count cleanup.
